title: Root: function
hook: Locate a plant feature and connect it to its role.

doesNotKnow: How the named plant feature contributes to plant function.

misconception: Every part of a plant performs the same role.
objective: Connect the named plant structure with one function.

claims.text: Which function is associated with the root? Root: Anchors the plant and absorbs water and minerals. The highlighted region locates one example, not the full microscopic structure.
